name: moonbridge
description: Call Kimi Code from Claude Code for delegation, review, and second opinions.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to Kimi, review changes, and get second opinions.
interface.longDescription: moonbridge lets Claude Code call the Kimi Code CLI for an independent second opinion, structured code review, and delegated coding tasks. Delegation runs in a throwaway git worktree and returns a reviewable diff that is never applied to your working tree. Because the kimi CLI has no sandbox, consult and review additionally run under a generated agent profile with no shell or write tools.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from Kimi on this approach.
Have Kimi review my current changes.
Delegate this task to Kimi and show me the proposed diff.
